{{Quote|You are our secret weapons.|Mace Windu, to the droids of D-Squad|<ref name="SW" />}}
'''D-Squad''' was a five-member [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] formed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], consisting of [[QT-KT/Legends|QT-KT]], [[U9-C4/Legends|U9-C4]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[M5-BZ/Legends|M5-BZ]], and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]]. Led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], D-Squad was sent to steal an [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] from a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Jedi Council placed in command of this most crucial operation an unexperienced military tactician and tasked a team of used droids to complete it. Their failure to complete their mission in a timely manner nearly resulted in the loss of all life at the Republic Valor strategy conference.|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], in a [[Reformation of Jedi military command|memorandum]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|
<ref name="FB">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsTheCloneWars|url=photo.php?fbid=494382640601035|name=Star Wars: The Clone Wars|date=2013-01-15|quote=We swiped this eye-opening memo from the desk of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.... could this be a sign of the times?|archivedate=20210402215625}}</ref>}}
After securing the encryption module, D-squad prepared to return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but their hyperspace calculation took them head first into a comet storm. After sustaining critical damage, the droids and [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] were forced to land on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] to find a new ship. The team walked through the desert-like "void" of Abafar for a significant time in search of a settlement, but to no avail. [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Gascon]], out of sheer despair, threw himself to the ground and he, along with [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]], stayed behind whilst the other droids continued on. Eventually, a stampede of [[Void Strider|avian creatures]] would carry them to a settlement, where the team was reunited and [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]] was promoted to the rank of [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] by [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Gascon]].<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>

The squad later made their way into the settlement. While Gascon sent the droids to search for "unfriendlies", he and WAC went into a diner owned by [[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]]. After announcing who they were, they were quickly shooed out. While searching for more food, they discovered [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], who worked as the dishwasher of the diner. Gascon determined that Gregor was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], but the man did not believe him, and did not even know what a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] was. He actually had amnesia, and later remembered his past.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

[[File:DevisingAGamePlan-MIA.png|thumb|left|250px|D-Squad enlisted the help of the clone commando, Gregor]]
After procuring Gregor's armor from Borkus, the D-Squad raced into the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] area, just outside the settlement, trying to board a ship to get off the planet. All of the droids except M5-BZ and Gascon made it to the ship easily. While Gregor held off the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], he helped M5-BZ and Gascon up. They safely got to the ship, but Gregor stayed below and continued to fight. He deactivated many battle droids, but was believed to be killed due to the sheer number of droids and explosions. Gascon promised that they would never forget Gregor's sacrifice and vowed to watch for his return.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

D-Squad then disembarked on the Republic cruiser in orbit of Abafar, where they discovered that the ship had been commandeered by Separatists. Upon encountering surviving Republic droids, D-Squad learns that the Separatists have loaded large quantities of [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]] aboard the cruiser, intending to blow it up at a space station in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]], the site of the Republic Strategy conference.<ref name="Point of No Return">{{TCW|Point of No Return}}</ref>

But before they could act on this information, Gascon and the Republic chased a [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droid]] to stop it from alerting the other battle droids. They chased the buzz droid into one of the gun batteries, only to find a whole swarm waiting for them. Surrounded, Artoo created a ring of fire around his compatriots to keep the buzz droids from getting at them. M5-BZ then made a daring move to blow the buzz droids out the airlock. The Republic droids quickly magnetized their feet to avoid being sucked out but Beezee was sucked out into hyperspace along with the buzz droids.<ref name="Point of No Return" />

Vowing to not let Beezee's sacrifice be in vain, Gascon came up with a plan to thwart the Separatist plot. As he led the droids back to their shuttle, Artoo went for the bomb trigger, intending to reprogram it to trigger the rhydonium to detonate prematurely. Unfortunately, a [[Unidentified super tactical droid (Carida)/Legends|super tactical droid]] was already prepping the detonator. Though Gascon wanted to go back for Artoo, WAC initiated takeoff. D-Squad managed to get to safety as Artoo managed to complete his task, destroying the cruiser before it could tear apart the station. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] dispatched salvage teams into the wreckage in search of the heroic astromech, who managed to find Artoo and repair him. Gascon commended Artoo's bravery and said that he'd be willing to serve with D-Squad again. WAC then told him that D-Squad and the other Republic droids have been assigned to his platoon, allowing them to see each other every day for the rest of the war. An unenthusiastic Gascon then started sobbing at this news.<ref name="Point of No Return" />
